# edgeos_dhcp_shared_network (Resource)

A DHCP server shared network and its subnets (`service dhcp-server shared-network-name <name>`).

Static mappings are managed with `edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping` and are never touched when this resource changes a subnet that stays in the config. Removing a subnet from `subnets` deletes that whole subnet on the router, including static mappings inside it. Options of a subnet that are not modelled here (`static-route`, `failover`, ...) are left alone unless the subnet is removed.

Destroying the resource deletes the whole shared network, including every subnet and static mapping in it, managed by Terraform or not. Global DHCP server settings (`service dhcp-server disabled`, `use-dnsmasq`, `hostfile-update`) are not part of this resource; use `edgeos_dhcp_server_settings` for those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_dhcp_shared_network" "lan" {
  name          = "LAN"
  description   = "Home network"
  authoritative = true

  subnets = {
    "192.168.1.0/24" = {
      default_router = "192.168.1.1"
      dns_servers    = ["192.168.1.1"]
      domain_name    = "home.arpa"
      lease          = 86400
      ranges = [
        { start = "192.168.1.100", stop = "192.168.1.199" },
      ]
      exclude = ["192.168.1.150"]
    }
  }
}

# A guest network with short leases and a public resolver.
resource "edgeos_dhcp_shared_network" "guest" {
  name = "GUEST"

  subnets = {
    "192.168.20.0/24" = {
      default_router = "192.168.20.1"
      dns_servers    = ["198.51.100.53", "203.0.113.53"]
      lease          = 3600
      ranges = [
        { start = "192.168.20.10", stop = "192.168.20.250" },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shared network name, such as `LAN`. Changing it creates a new shared network.
- `subnets` (Attributes Map) Subnets served by this shared network, keyed by network in CIDR notation such as `192.168.1.0/24`. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

### Optional

- `authoritative` (Boolean) Answer as the authoritative server for the network, so clients with leases from elsewhere get a DHCPNAK (`authoritative enable`). Unset leaves the node out, which EdgeOS treats as disabled.
- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Keep the shared network in the config but switch it off (the `disable` node). Defaults to `false`.
- `shared_network_parameters` (List of String) Raw ISC dhcpd statements for the shared network block (`shared-network-parameters`). Write double quotes as `&quot;`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The shared network name.

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Optional:

- `bootfile_name` (String) Boot file name for network boot (`bootfile-name`, DHCP option 67).
- `default_router` (String) Gateway handed to clients (`default-router`).
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS servers handed to clients, in order of preference (`dns-server`).
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name handed to clients, such as `home.arpa` (`domain-name`).
- `exclude` (Set of String) Addresses inside the pools that are never leased (`exclude`).
- `lease` (Number) Lease time in seconds, at least 120. EdgeOS uses 86400 (one day) when unset.
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) NTP servers handed to clients (`ntp-server`, DHCP option 42).
- `ranges` (Attributes Set) Address pools (`start <start> stop <stop>`). Both ends must be inside the subnet, and pools must not overlap. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets--ranges))
- `subnet_parameters` (List of String) Raw ISC dhcpd statements added to the subnet block (`subnet-parameters`), such as `option domain-search &quot;example.com&quot;;`. EdgeOS does not allow double quotes in values; write them as `&quot;`.
- `tftp_server_name` (String) TFTP server name or address for network boot (`tftp-server-name`, DHCP option 66).
- `time_servers` (List of String) RFC 868 time servers handed to clients (`time-server`, DHCP option 4).
- `unifi_controller` (String) Address of a UniFi controller handed to UniFi devices (`unifi-controller`).
- `wins_servers` (List of String) NetBIOS name servers handed to clients (`wins-server`).

<a id="nestedatt--subnets--ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets.ranges`

Required:

- `start` (String) First address of the pool.
- `stop` (String) Last address of the pool.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <shared network name>
terraform import edgeos_dhcp_shared_network.lan LAN
```
